summary: Protect installer secrets with Ansible Vault: put admin_password, pg_password and registry_password in `credentials.yml`, run `ansible-vault encrypt`, then run `./setup.sh -e @credentials.yml -- --ask-vault-pass`.
questions: How do I encrypt passwords in the AAP installer inventory?
Keep registry_password out of the inventory file

answer_card.title: Vault-encrypt installer credentials
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cat > credentials.yml <<EOF
admin_password: my_long_admin_pw
pg_password: my_long_pg_pw
registry_password: my_long_registry_pw
EOF
ansible-vault encrypt credentials.yml
ANSIBLE_BECOME_METHOD='sudo' ANSIBLE_BECOME=True ANSIBLE_HOST_KEY_CHECKING=False \
  ./setup.sh -e @credentials.yml -- --ask-vault-pass
```
